subject: Aurora Labs: confirmation & schedule for prompt/output/log purge
messages:
From: Susan Kelly <susan.kelly@auroralabs.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: audit-team@auroralabs.com
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 16:12:00 +01:00
Subject: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs for Aurora - EU residency

Hi Lauren,

Aurora is preparing for a regulator-led data minimization exercise and we need Redwood's help to fully purge all model prompts, generated outputs, and request logs tied to our EU tenancy (tenant id: AU-8892-EU). We completed the internal intake form and attached it to this message.

What we need from Redwood:
- A concise ops workflow describing the exact steps your team will execute (including KV cache, S3 artifacts, and analytics traces).
- Expected timeline: earliest start and estimated completion.
- Evidence of deletion (hash manifests, a signed certificate of execution, and a listing of files removed).

We'd prefer the purge to run in the next 10 business days. Can you confirm feasibility and, if needed, a mutually agreeable window? Also confirm whether any backups (snapshots) or long-term monitoring traces will be impacted and how you'll handle them.

Thanks,
Susan Kelly
Head of IT Compliance
Aurora Labs

Attachments: Aurora_deletion_request_form.pdf (application/pdf, 142 KB)

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Susan Kelly <susan.kelly@auroralabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 10:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs for Aurora - EU residency

Hi Susan — thanks for the intake form, and for outlining the evidence you need. We can run this for the Aurora EU tenancy. High level plan below; I pasted it here so it's clear for audit.

Proposed purge workflow (summary):
1) Intake validation: confirm exact tenant IDs, list of models & routes, and any exclusion lists (24 hours).
2) Snapshot & safekeep: create a temporary snapshot of metadata for audit only (MD5 manifest; snapshot stored encrypted and automatically deleted after 7 days unless you request otherwise).
3) KV cache invalidation: invalidate model KV caches and remove prefix entries associated with tenant (runtime operation).
4) Artifact removal: delete S3 buckets/objects holding prompt/output derivatives and intermediate logs (we will use server-side delete flags + object version expunge).
5) Analytics traces: redact PII and remove request-level traces as agreed (we will provide a redaction manifest).
6) Evidence delivery: deliver a signed certificate + deletion manifest (file listing hashes, deletion timestamps) and a short ops runbook describing commands used.

Estimated timeline: start within 5 business days after your written approval; completion within 48 hours of start for the scoped tenant (assuming no exclusions). If there are >1,000,000 derivative objects, we will need a small extension (up to 5 business days).

Attachments: redwood-deletion-runbook-v2.pdf (pdf, 310 KB) — contains the exact S3/object/kv steps we will run.

Can you confirm: 1) final scope (models/routes to include), 2) whether you require retention of any artifacts for internal audit, and 3) preferred start window. Once confirmed, I will schedule an ops window and share the runbook with our Ops team.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Manager, Customer Security & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Thanks Lauren — quick ops note from our side for the runbook & timing.

Ops checklist (detailed):
- Confirmed tenant object count via inventory call (we'll run a dry-list to estimate object versions; this is non-destructive).
- Prepare ephemeral snapshot (manifest stored in our audit bucket; ACL = private; TTL = 7 days).
- Run KV prefix sweep: iterator will remove keys with prefix tenant/au-8892/*; this is atomic-per-shard, expected 30-90 minutes depending on shard count.
- Object deletion: use multi-part delete for large objects; ensure Versioning-aware expunge. We'll run deletes from a dedicated purge instance to avoid throttling production clusters.
- Analytics trace redaction: our pipeline will replace request-level PII with placeholders; we will then remove original traces.
- Post-check: re-run listing to confirm zero objects for scope; produce manifest and sign.

Risks & mitigations:
- Backup windows: we will check snapshot schedules and hold any region-level snapshots until after purge verification to ensure no hidden copies remain.
- Cross-region replicas: confirm no cross-region sync for tenant (Susan, please confirm).

Proposed ops window: Aug 3 2026 0200–0800 UTC (this maps to Aug 3 04:00–10:00 CEST) — minimal customer impact and low traffic. If Aurora needs earlier, we can consider Aug 2 22:00–02:00 UTC.

I will own the run and produce the deletion-evidence-20260730.zip once complete.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
